foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

cutoff.note: BLS publication time is explicit. The Kraken and rendered aggregator captures have no exact provider event timestamp; 13:43:13Z is a conservative retrieval upper bound, not a provider timestamp.

receipt.scope: Exact 463-character normalized excerpt recorded in this artifact: title, embargo/publication time, payroll/unemployment headline, earnings paragraph and August/September revision paragraph. This is not a hash of the full HTML or complete HTTP bytes.

source_registry.method: Reuters economist survey; forecast values are expectations, not observations.
Reports a separate economist expectation of 59,000 payrolls and interprets the rate-policy implications; do not merge its survey median with Reuters.
Reports dollar and Treasury-yield response; not an exchange-native receipt.
Reports the November 5 equity/AI selloff and subsequent jobs surprise; not an independent primary market-data feed.

receipt.scope: Exact 317-character JSON text rendered by the retrieval interface; not byte-complete HTTP wire bytes.

source_registry.method: Seven-exchange OI aggregation; five-exchange liquidation and account-ratio sample.
All-venue aggregation; liquidation clusters and leverage-within-2% figures are modelled estimates, not guaranteed or exchange-reported executable levels.
Issuer-reported holdings deltas across six US spot funds plus BITW XRP sleeve; flow-excluded funds count as zero, and some daily rows may be reconstructed or provisional.

wsj_reported_survey.note: Different survey vintage/universe; retained as disagreement, not averaged with Reuters.

ft.interpretation: Stronger hiring increased market bets on higher rates.

wsj.interpretation: Strong payrolls may not change the Federal Reserve's rate plans because inflation remains above target.

market_reaction_reporting.disagreement: FT describes a higher-rate repricing; WSJ argues the report may not change the Fed's policy path. These are interpretations, not a settled causal result.

kraken_xrp_usd.depth_status: Top-of-book only. The attempted public depth endpoint was not accessible through the retrieval interface; no multi-level depth or executable slippage estimate is claimed.

tradradar_derivatives.note: The venue rows sum to $1.91689B, consistent with a rounded $1.92B headline. Liquidations are a lower bound.

alpha_finance_derivatives.note: Different aggregation universe from TradRadar; do not average its $2.78B OI with TradRadar's seven-exchange $1.92B.

etf_holdings_delta.tracked_universe: Six US spot XRP funds plus BITW XRP sleeve
etf_holdings_delta.method: Issuer-reported holdings day-over-day changes; flow-excluded funds count as zero. Some rows may be reconstructed/provisional.
etf_holdings_delta.interpretation_limit: Holdings deltas are not direct AP cash creations/redemptions, ETF share flows, or proof of open-market XRP purchases.

event_timeline.event: Broad US equity/AI and semiconductor selloff preceded the BLS release.
BLS published the October Employment Situation; 165,000 payroll gain, 4.1% unemployment, 0.4% monthly and 3.1% annual hourly-earnings growth.
Conservative retrieval upper bound for the Kraken ticker and post-release market pages; not an exchange event timestamp.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The November 5 broad equity/AI selloff and leveraged-long unwind explain most of the XRP decline observed before the BLS release.
supporting_evidence: Nasdaq -5.5%, S&P 500 -4.36%, Dow -3.44% on November 5 in secondary market reporting.
TradRadar shows falling OI, $18.68M long versus $648.78K short liquidations, and 79.9% long accounts.
disconfirming_evidence: No synchronized BTC/ETH/XRP event-window beta or trade-level sequencing was captured.
XRP-specific OTC, wallet and order-book depth data are incomplete.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The stronger payroll and wage surprise may add post-release pressure to risk assets through higher yields and a stronger dollar, but cannot explain the pre-release decline.
supporting_evidence: Payrolls exceeded the Reuters survey by 100,000; wages were 0.1 percentage point hotter monthly and 0.2 point hotter annually.
FT reports the two-year yield rose 6 basis points to 4.53% and the dollar strengthened.
disconfirming_evidence: WSJ argues the release may not change the Federal Reserve's rate plans.
No synchronized minute-level XRP/yield/dollar event study is available.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The four-settled-day ETF holdings decline may be a marginal demand headwind, not a sufficient explanation for the selloff.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -149,487 XRP across November 2–5.
disconfirming_evidence: The change is about -0.0125% of reported total holdings.
The measure is a holdings delta, not AP cash redemption data; some rows are reconstructed or excluded.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Long liquidations and falling OI likely amplified the move, without proving that derivatives initiated the spot decline.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports OI down 6.12%, at least $19.33M liquidations, with long liquidations far exceeding shorts and positive funding.
disconfirming_evidence: Aggregators use different venue universes and methodologies.
No exchange-native synchronized liquidation tape and spot depth were captured.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: An XRP-specific catalyst remains possible but is not established by this evidence set.
supporting_evidence: No primary XRP-specific event in this capture explains the broad cross-asset timing.
disconfirming_evidence: The monitoring set is incomplete for OTC, wallet attribution and private institutional flows.

data_quality.bls_primary_data: Official BLS release text; excerpt hash only, not full-page byte receipt.
data_quality.kraken_timestamp: No provider event timestamp; only a retrieval upper bound is recorded.
data_quality.spot_depth: Top-of-book only; no multi-level depth, impact curve or slippage estimate.
data_quality.binance_depth: Depth endpoint not accessible through the current retrieval interface.
data_quality.derivatives: TradRadar and Alpha Finance are separate aggregators with different universes; do not combine headline OI or liquidation totals.
data_quality.etf_flows: Issuer-holdings deltas, not cash creations/redemptions; flow-excluded and reconstructed/provisional rows remain limitations.
data_quality.macro_surveys: Reuters and WSJ report different survey medians (65,000 versus 59,000); preserve both rather than average.
data_quality.market_reaction: FT and WSJ interpretations differ on policy implications; neither establishes XRP causality.
data_quality.event_window: No synchronized minute-level XRP, BTC, yields, dollar and equity observations around 13:30 UTC.

model_admission.reason: Research-only event snapshot. Kraken provider time and depth are incomplete; aggregator inputs are not raw exchange receipts; no synchronized event window or evaluator-attested model test exists.

forecast_status.reason: No validated fixed-horizon out-of-sample lift, calibrated probabilities or synchronized event-window data. No directional probability is justified.
